results.question: Why was recurring billing taken out of the Atlas launch scope?
results.answer: Recurring billing was taken out of the Atlas launch scope because the payments API v2 launch scope covers one-off charges, refunds, and webhooks only. The basic fraud rules ([ATL-130]) are not designed for recurring charges. Keeping subscriptions in scope would put the launch date at risk. [NTN-105]
